summary: Resume local operation audit interrupts without a zero-row retry cliff

rules.detail: Audit frontiers and drift verification are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A local audit slice interrupt no longer becomes a fatal SQLite error after three empty attempts. Empty interrupted slices double their minimum VM work allowance until the finite seek returns a row or EOF. Caller cancellation and external interrupts remain errors. Each attempt releases its snapshot before retrying.

manual.detail: The operation audit page slice debug event reports slice_count, interrupt_count, rows_per_slice, local_interrupt, minimum_vm_callbacks and elapsed_ms. The snapshot duration target is cooperative; expensive zero-row seeks can need more work than one local time slice.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback needs no data conversion.
